Python.recommendation: Build a small project in Python (e.g., CLI tool, scraper, or REST API) to reinforce fundamentals.

Django.recommendation: Follow the official Django tutorial and build a blog or todo app with authentication.

Flask.recommendation: Build a minimal REST API with Flask and deploy it to a free host.

FastAPI.recommendation: Recreate a Flask API in FastAPI to compare design patterns and async support.

Docker.recommendation: Learn Docker fundamentals and containerize one existing Python project. Write a Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml.

Kubernetes.recommendation: After Docker, complete a beginner Kubernetes course and deploy a simple app to a local minikube cluster.

AWS.recommendation: Study AWS core services (EC2, S3, IAM) via AWS Skill Builder. Deploy a small app to EC2 free tier.

Azure.recommendation: Complete Microsoft Learn's Azure Fundamentals path (AZ-900).

GCP.recommendation: Explore Google Cloud free tier — deploy a Cloud Run service from a container.

Git.recommendation: Practice branching, rebasing, and pull requests on a personal repo. Learn to write clear commit messages.

GitHub.recommendation: Contribute to an open-source project — start with documentation fixes or small bug fixes.

CI/CD.recommendation: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs tests and lints your Python project on every push.

SQL.recommendation: Practice joins, subqueries, and window functions on a real dataset using SQLite or PostgreSQL.

PostgreSQL.recommendation: Set up PostgreSQL locally, design a small schema, and write queries to answer realistic business questions.

MySQL.recommendation: Build a small CRUD app backed by MySQL. Learn indexes and EXPLAIN plans.

MongoDB.recommendation: Model a real dataset (e.g., blog posts, products) in MongoDB and learn aggregation pipelines.

Redis.recommendation: Add Redis caching to an existing web app. Measure query latency before and after.

React.recommendation: Build a small interactive UI (todo, dashboard) with React. Learn hooks and state management.

JavaScript.recommendation: Solidify JS fundamentals: closures, promises, async/await. Build a browser extension or small game.

TypeScript.recommendation: Convert a small JS project to TypeScript. Learn interfaces, generics, and type narrowing.

REST API.recommendation: Practice designing and consuming REST APIs using FastAPI or Django REST Framework. Document with OpenAPI.

GraphQL.recommendation: Build a GraphQL API with Apollo or Graphene. Compare with REST on the same dataset.

Machine Learning.recommendation: Complete Andrew Ng's ML Specialization (Coursera). Implement one algorithm from scratch (e.g., linear regression).

Deep Learning.recommendation: Build a small neural network from scratch in NumPy, then reproduce it in PyTorch.

NLP.recommendation: Work through Hugging Face's NLP course. Build a text classifier on a public dataset.

Computer Vision.recommendation: Complete the PyImageSearch or fast.ai CV lessons. Train a small CNN on CIFAR-10.

TensorFlow.recommendation: Complete TensorFlow's official tutorials. Rebuild one project in Keras.

PyTorch.recommendation: Work through the official PyTorch 60-minute blitz. Implement an image classifier on a small dataset.

Pandas.recommendation: Practice groupby, merge, pivot, and time series on a real CSV from Kaggle.

NumPy.recommendation: Work through the NumPy quickstart. Reimplement a small math operation vectorized vs loop-based.

scikit-learn.recommendation: Build an end-to-end ML pipeline (preprocessing → model → evaluation) on a Kaggle dataset.

Linux.recommendation: Learn basic shell commands: file navigation, permissions, processes, pipes. Practice on WSL or a VM.

Agile.recommendation: Read the Agile Manifesto and one Scrum guide. Practice writing user stories and estimating.

Scrum.recommendation: Complete a free Scrum Fundamentals course. Learn the roles, ceremonies, and artifacts.

Communication.recommendation: Practice explaining your projects in 2 minutes. Record yourself and review.

Leadership.recommendation: Lead a small team project (college, club, or hackathon). Reflect on what worked.

Problem Solving.recommendation: Solve 2 LeetCode easy problems per day for 2 weeks. Track patterns you notice.
